findings.text: The done-when clause that this test passes at head is unmet and cannot be met inside this node's write paths: it fails at both arms because 13 modules breach the 50,000-token bound at the base revision, reckon/crew_follow_commands.py among them (50,277 tokens at 50cf9e4e, 51,026 at 92648a3115). The worker disclosed it under outside_scope and blockers; the repair needs a node whose scope covers those modules.

_logged_reload_failure scans the whole 4 KiB producer-log tail for any line naming a watch command plus a failure marker, without binding that line to the reload the seat record's marker describes. A failure line left in the tail by an earlier, since-superseded reload reports the next in-window reload at once, which is the same false row this node set out to stop; producer_reload_failure_reported resets per follower so nothing suppresses it across a re-arm.

The manifest's status reads complete while its blockers line names an unmet done-when clause and its checkpoint calls that clause unattainable; a terminal status should read blocked so a promotion guard sees the outstanding condition rather than only a terminal word.
